scope_note: The official stenographic report of the extraordinary Third Congress, volume III, as a page-image scan (340 PDF pages). The sixth sitting of 14 March 1990 (printed pp. 3-4 and 22) and the seventh sitting of 15 March 1990 (printed pp. 54 and 82) were read for the Soyuz group's nominations; a member's statement of 14 March (printed p. 9) states no office and is not imported. The scan is hosted by the non-official SSSR.SU project; the recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff, byte-identical to the live static file (live_file_response).

visual_review.method: Every cited page was rendered from the recorded bytes with PyMuPDF (100-150 dpi) and read from the page image, not from the OCR layer; the sitting headings, speaker lines and quotations were compared with the image, and the title page and imprint were read for the edition.

rows.role_title_as_printed: The passage prints no office in the group for the speaker.
rows.text: At the sixth sitting (14 March 1990, 17:45, 'Председательствует Первый заместитель Председателя Верховного Совета СССР А. И. Лукьянов'), 'Алкснис В. И., полковник, старший инженер-инспектор войсковой части, г. Рига' says that 'Вчера депутат Блохин проинформировал вас о том, что депутатская группа «Союз» на своем общем собрании предлагает внести в список кандидатур для тайного голосования на пост Президента СССР' three candidates, and asks that they be entered in the list.
rows.locator: Sixth sitting: heading, printed p. 3 (PDF p. 5); speech, printed p. 4 (PDF p. 6)

rows.text: In the same sitting the presiding officer states: 'Хочу напомнить, что депутатская группа «Союз», которая выдвинула кандидатуру товарища Бакатина, насчитывает более 300 человек. Она имеет право на выдвижение...'

rows.role_title_as_printed: The passage prints no office in the group for the speaker.
rows.text: At the seventh sitting (15 March 1990), 'Ким Е. У., член Верховного Совета СССР' says: 'Я хочу довести до вас решение общего собрания депутатской группы «Союз». Депутатская группа «Союз» выдвигает в качестве кандидата на пост Председателя Верховного Совета СССР трех товарищей', naming three candidates in alphabetical order.
rows.locator: Seventh sitting: heading, printed p. 54 (PDF p. 56); statement, printed p. 82 (PDF p. 84)

bounded_scope: Democratic Russia movement and Soyuz deputies' group observations for CLAUDE-C01-35 only. Founding, selection or election, statements, nominations, registration, leadership references by other deputies, membership statements and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Co-chairs are recorded as co-leadership, one person per holder observation. State offices, the CPSU, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
